high_level_description: The image is a news article snippet about Godawan Century, a single malt whiskey from India, winning the highest score in the single malt whiskey category at the 2024 London Spirits Competition. The text highlights that Godawan Century secured an impressive score of 96 points, solidifying its position as the premier single malt whiskey globally. The image itself shows a close-up of a bottle of whiskey labeled "Whisky" with a handwritten style. Next to the bottle, there are two small glasses filled with the same golden-colored liquid, likely the whiskey being showcased.
